card.name: Words before superlatives like greatest, leading
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, of, some, to, be) right before a superlative or praise phrase such as 'greatest thinkers' or 'most important figures' in descriptive web text. Also fires on URL and citation pieces such as 'bit.ly' or 'PubMed:'.

modes.label: Before praise phrases
modes.description: A linking word that sets up a superlative or 'leading' description of people or works.
modes.example: He is regarded as the father of modern medicine, and one of<< the>> greatest thinkers and medical scholars in history.

modes.label: Links and citation marks
modes.description: Pieces of shortened URLs or PubMed citation markers after a source line.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like 'best', 'most' and 'crucial' (many in Chinese), which suggests superlative or praise wording comes next.
card.plain: It fires on small words that lead into 'the greatest' or 'most important' descriptions, and on some web link pieces.
